findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: text-to-structure, email-verify, text-extract · Private data: text-to-structure, email-verify, domain-lookup, dex-quote · Public sink: email-verify, text-extract · Destructive: hash-tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: text-to-structure, email-verify, text-extract · Private data: text-to-structure, email-verify, domain-lookup, dex-quote · Public sink: email-verify, text-extract · Destructive: hash-tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
